title: Width-truncated circuit representation
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, let $C$ be a depth circuit on the $n$-dimensional sign cube, and let $w$ be a nonnegative integer. The function computed by the circuit obtained from $C$ by truncating its first-layer terms to width at most $w$ has a depth-$\mathrm{depth}(C)$ representation of size at most $\mathrm{size}(C)$ and width at most $w$.
hypotheses_covered: A depth circuit C on the n-dimensional sign cube
